name: Externalization multi-agent scheduler and failure instrumentation patch
purpose: Fix the Item085 prelaunch blocker at the runner-mechanics level by adding checkpoint resume/skip-completed behavior, bounded row-budgeted execution, task batch sizing, and team NO_RECOVERY_TARGET failure reasons. Validate the scheduler mechanics with a fast no-LLM resume check; this is not a new L0 baseline and not a claim 4b result.

code_added_used.change: Adds checkpoint resume loading, duplicate row-key skipping, --task-batch-size, --max-new-rows, --no-resume, budget ledger fields for those controls, and team failure_reason values for NO_RECOVERY_TARGET/CALL_CAP paths.

commands.command: Repeat the same no-LLM command against the same checkpoint.
commands.purpose: Second scheduler check invocation: verify resume skips the completed team row and appends the next missing arm rather than duplicating.

headline.single_next_move: Run K shards as small resumable row-budgeted chunks, starting with K=2 max_new_rows increments, before reopening the full K={2,3,4,6}, n>=30 launch.

gate_outcomes.number: Two invocations with max_new_rows=1 produced two unique row keys: team then monolith_R; no duplicate row keys.
Runner exposes --task-batch-size and --max-new-rows so future real-LLM shards can be split into resumable chunks.
Team rows now include failure_reason for call_cap, local/cross-block culprit out-of-register-view, missing blockers, and missing target trail cases.
No real-LLM claim read is added; scheduler check used no-LLM mode only.
No new calibration or no-LLM baseline was generated; no-LLM check was a mechanics test only.

decision.next_step_routing: Use the patched runner for split-K, row-budgeted real-LLM execution: e.g. K=2 with --task-batch-size 1 or 2 and --max-new-rows small, then resume until n is sufficient. Do not launch all K and all arms in one future set until runtime tails are characterized.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not establish or refute claim 4b. It only patches runner mechanics and verifies resume/skip behavior with a no-LLM scheduler check.
honesty.no_llm_check_scope: The no-LLM check is not a baseline or calibration expansion; it is a fast deterministic way to test checkpoint mechanics.
honesty.remaining_limit: There is still no hard per-request cancellation inside a Python thread. Real-LLM shards should be run in small resumable batches or separate process-level chunks.
